ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to less than 2% of the total fluke area, primarily located in localized scars and spray.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Localized high-contrast blobs are minimal; primary features include a thin vertical line on the right lobe at the mid-proximal region and small, faint white mottling clusters at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 70-80 degrees; depth relative to the fluke span is approximately 12% of the vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge shows continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; several distinct jagged peaks and notches are visible, notably on the outer third of the right lobe trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a broadly concave arc from notch to tip on both lobes, while the visible leading edges maintain a roughly linear trajectory with slight terminal convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible as scattered, small white circular clusters of high-intensity pixels along the distal margins and tips, likely corresponding to barnacle attachment points or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent vertical linear mark on the right medial-lobe spanning approximately 20% of the lobe height; secondary faint, unaligned scratches are visible on the left lobe's distal ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical scar on the right lobe; irregular, non-symmetrical notches and tissue loss on the lateral tip of the right lobe trailing edge suggesting prior physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform dark pigmentation (Category 1) with high-density black pixels over nearly the entire visible ventral surface, providing a highly distinctive low-contrast baseline.
